note: Prices copied from each vendor's own Australian pricing page on the date above. Re-check before relying on them.

servicem8.name: ServiceM8
servicem8.model: Priced by how many new jobs you create each month. Every paid plan includes unlimited users.
servicem8.trial: 14-day free trial; a free plan for 1 user and 30 jobs a month.

tradify.name: Tradify
tradify.model: Priced per user, per month, with no cap on jobs.
tradify.trial: 14-day free trial. Optional add-ons: an instant website ($19 a month) and SMS quotes and invoices (20c a message).

fergus.name: Fergus
fergus.model: Priced per user, per month ("from" prices), with no lock-in contract. Timesheet-only staff cost less (from $26 a month).
fergus.trial: Free trial and a free 1-hour onboarding session. The pricing page also shows a lower introductory price, so check the current offer.

bigger: For larger businesses (roughly 10+ staff, service contracts, assets), AroFlo and simPRO are the usual names. They quote prices on request, so we don't list them here.
